name: library-management-system
description: Library Management System with React frontend and Express backend

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../admin-frontend && npm run build
scripts.dev-all: concurrently "npm run backend-start" "npm run frontend-dev" "npm run admin-frontend-dev"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../admin-frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
